problem: Ten existing visible solution placements had offering-level evidence but no reviewed relationship-level evidence. Two wound-assessment fits needed narrower wording.
result: 15 exact saved evidence links added to ten placements; two statements narrowed. No new objects, offerings, sources, media or hypothesis upgrades.

whole_graph_presence_audit.limit: Presence audit does not prove semantic fitness of every unreviewed historical link; this pass reviewed the ten identified placements.

review.situation: High laundry demand creates costs but reducing it could affect hygiene or comfort

review.situation: Energy-saving changes make rooms uncomfortable for residents
review.fit_statement: Per-room control may help adapt heating to resident requirements; energy savings and resident comfort are supplier claims, not established outcomes.
